title: Tap Targets
description: A tiny reflex game that proves the Playbox contract end to end: settings, haptics, pause/resume, saved scores and exit all go through the shared SDK.
howTo: Tap the glowing targets before their ring closes.
Chain hits for a combo bonus; a miss resets it.
Score as much as you can in 30 seconds.

description: The classic number-merging puzzle. Swipe to slide every tile; equal tiles merge into their sum. Reach 2048, then keep going for a high score. Your game autosaves, so you can pick up where you left off.
howTo: Swipe (or use arrow keys / WASD) to slide all tiles.
Two equal tiles that touch merge into one — once per move.
Reach 2048 to win; the game ends when no moves are left.
Z undoes your last move (one step).

title: Score Four
description: Drop beads onto a 4×4 peg board and line up four in any direction — rows, columns, diagonals and through the layers. Pass-and-play on one device.
howTo: Take turns dropping a bead on any peg.
Beads stack, so think in height as well as width.

title: Orbit Dash
description: One-thumb arcade: time your release to hop between orbits and chase a high score.

title: Pixel Pairs
tagline: A memory duel against a friend.
description: Flip cards, find matching pairs, and out-remember your opponent on the same screen.

title: Stack Duel
tagline: Race to build the tallest tower, online.
description: Real-time tower building against players around the world.
